name: maple-api-key
description: Maple's official remote MCP server for OpenTelemetry observability. Query services, traces, logs, metrics, errors, session replays and agent sessions, and run read-only SQL. It also has write tools that triage error issues, edit dashboards, and create or delete alert rules, silences and on-call schedules, and Opulent allows every tool the server lists once it is connected. To keep the agent read-only, open the plugin's sheet after connecting, expand Tools → Limit tools (advanced), uncheck the write tools and save. Connects to the US region (api.maple.dev) with a Maple API key or MCP key (maple_ak_…); a restricted API key's scopes also limit what the tools can do.
